mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust supply chain activity and corporate capacity utilization, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic expansion continues.
failure_condition: INDPRO level fails to predict positive returns in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS) falls below 50,000, it signals a weakening labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS growth is below 50,000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent negative quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and declining housing starts (HOUST) signal a severe demand slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to recessionary fears.
failure_condition: The joint signal of negative GDPC1 and falling HOUST fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), rising inflation pressures prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of high inflation regime instances, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
